description: This file implements a routing strategy class 'LowestCostLoggingHandler' for selecting and logging model deployment based on response time and cost metrics. It manages cache interactions, logs success events, calculates cost metrics, and provides deployment selection logic based on real-time usage data.

classes.name: LowestCostLoggingHandler
classes.description: A custom logger handler that tracks and logs model response costs and response times, manages cache updates, and determines the lowest cost deployment based on real-time usage metrics.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful model response event, updating cache metrics for tokens and response times, used for cost calculation.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous version of log_success_event, updates cache metrics in an async context.

methods.name: async_get_available_deployments( self, model_group: str, healthy_deployments: list, messages: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None, input: Optional[Union[str, List]] = None, request_kwargs: Optional[Dict] = None, )
methods.description: Determines and returns the deployment with the lowest estimated cost and load, considering current usage metrics and limits.
